fixes.explanation: Not quite, baker. The LORD gives no date like that. He says, "I will go down to see if their actions fully justify the outcry that has reached Me. If not, I will find out." (Genesis 18:21). So the plan is to go down and see for Himself. A calendar never comes up in what He says.

That's a real title, friend, but it's not the one Abraham uses here. "The Shepherd of Israel" shows up in Psalm 80:1. Abraham says, "Will not the Judge of all the earth do what is right?" (Genesis 18:25). The title he speaks is Judge, and that's the one on this card.

Other way around, friend. Abraham asks about the fifty lacking five, and the LORD replies, "If I find forty-five there, I will not destroy it." (Genesis 18:28). So forty-five is enough for Him to hold off. The statement is true.

Not this one, baker. Fifteen never comes up in this conversation. After thirty, Abraham says, "…suppose twenty are found there?" (Genesis 18:31). The LORD answers, "On account of the twenty, I will not destroy it."
